title: Syrphidae of Italy (SoI): website code
description:
Source code of the Syrphidae of Italy (SoI) website (https://syrphidaeitaly.com), the open catalogue of Italian hoverflies (Diptera: Syrphidae). The code contains the SoI-specific panels, pages and configuration built on TaxonPages, the open-source front end of TaxonWorks (Species File Group); the TaxonPages core is merged at build time and is not included here. The website reads the SoI project in TaxonWorks live through its public API.

Data releases: https://github.com/SyrphidaeOfItaly/soi-releases. Occurrence data on GBIF: doi:10.15468/faryxm.
